messages:
Elaine: Heads-up: Go SDK v2 is released and documented. Breaking changes listed in the migration guide: https://docs.redwood.inference/go/v2-migration. Read before upgrading.

Sam: Is there an automated migration helper?

Elaine: Yes, small CLI helper at tools/go-migrate-sdk. Example: `go run ./cmd/migrate --from v1 --to v2 ./project`. It rewrites common client init patterns and import paths; manual review still needed.

Jess: I deployed redirects so /go/sdk/* v1 pages redirect to v2 pages. Canonical examples moved to /go/docs/examples/v2.

Mike: Note: retry semantics changed in v2 (now fails fast on 4xx). Tests relying on implicit retries will fail. See CHANGELOG -> "Retry semantics".

Phil: Auth header changed: v1 used `X-Redwood-Api-Key`, v2 expects `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Notify Dedicated/Private infra teams — some proxies strip custom headers.

doc-bot: PR #512 merged (docs + redirects).

Elaine: Deprecation timeline: v1 will receive security fixes only for 90 days from today, then become unsupported. Please open migration tickets for blocking customers.

Sam: Streaming API shape changed: returns a `Streamer` interface now instead of raw channels. Can we add an example converting old code?

Elaine: Added conversion snippet to the migration guide and queued a code example PR. Assigning @jess to author and @mike to review runtime effects.

Jess: Reviewers assigned: @mike (runtime), @phil (auth/security wording).

Mike: I'll add a minimal test harness showing new retry + streaming behavior.

Elaine: TL;DR: read the migration guide, run the migration helper, verify auth header handling in infra, and plan for a 90-day migration window. I'll post an internal FAQ later today. :tada: 

Phil: I'll draft the Dedicated/Private customer advisory and share it with #customer-success for review.

Sam: Thanks — kicking off a migration ticket for an integrator depending on old retry semantics.

Elaine: If you see doc errors or need extra examples, drop them here or open a docs issue.

doc-bot: changelog: published release notes v2.0.0 - https://changelog.redwood.inference/releases/go/v2.0.0
